appDescription: AI-powered promotion overlap control for Inochi

welcome.title: Welcome to Promotion Control
welcome.description: This AI-powered system helps you manage promotions without conflicts. Let's take a quick tour of the key features.

calendar.title: Promotion Calendar
calendar.description: View all your promotions on a timeline. See what's active now, upcoming, and identify potential overlap periods at a glance.
calendar.tip: The calendar is your mission control for all promotions

promotions.title: Manage Promotions
promotions.description: Create, edit, and organize all your promotions. Set target segments, channels, dates, and discount rules.
promotions.tip: Use filters to quickly find specific promotions

alerts.title: Conflict Detection
alerts.description: AI automatically detects conflicts like time overlaps, segment clashes, and stacking violations. Critical issues are highlighted for immediate attention.
alerts.tip: Check alerts regularly to prevent revenue loss

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.description: Track promotion performance, see distributions by status, type, and segment. Make data-driven decisions about your promotion strategy.
analytics.tip: Use analytics to optimize your promotion mix

complete.title: You're All Set!
complete.description: You now know the basics. Start by exploring the calendar or create your first promotion. Need help? Click the help icon anytime.
complete.tip: You can restart this tour from the help menu
